description: GitHub's own auto-merge is not used: with no required status checks on main, GitHub would be free to merge a Renovate branch before CI has even started. Renovate merges the branch itself instead, and it only does that once the branch is green.

packageRules.description: Development tooling never reaches a user of this package, so a green CI is enough to take a patch or a minor.
Runtime dependencies decide what the linter reports, so every upgrade is reviewed by hand.
